# clearml Provider

Manages ClearML projects, execution queues, and focused Enterprise access and resource-policy configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Credentials are read from CLEARML_API_ACCESS_KEY and
# CLEARML_API_SECRET_KEY. CLEARML_API_HOST is optional.
provider "clearml" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_key` (String, Sensitive) ClearML access key. Defaults to CLEARML_API_ACCESS_KEY when unset.
- `api_host` (String) ClearML API host. Defaults to CLEARML_API_HOST, then https://api.clear.ml.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) ClearML secret key. Defaults to CLEARML_API_SECRET_KEY when unset.
